GHSA-8q59-q68h-6hv4.note: Review reason: module_level yaml.constructor (lib3/yaml/constructor.py). The vulnerable code is not a function but three module-level statements, FullConstructor.add_multi_constructor for the python/module:, python/object: and python/object/new: tag prefixes (:713-723), which the fix moves to UnsafeConstructor. They run when yaml.constructor is imported and store construct_python_module, construct_python_object and construct_python_object_new in FullConstructor.yaml_multi_constructors (add_multi_constructor, :166). BaseConstructor.construct_object (:67) looks every node's tag prefix up in that table (:82-85) and calls the constructor (:102), so any FullConstructor-based load of a document with one of those tags uses the registrations. construct_object is reached from get_single_data / get_data -> construct_document (:47, :42, :54), which yaml.load and yaml.load_all call on the loader they build (__init__.py:114, :130); both default to FullLoader (:110, :125), and full_load / full_load_all pass FullLoader explicitly (:142, :152). FullLoader (loader.py:21) and CFullLoader (cyaml.py:30, exported as yaml.CFullLoader only when libyaml is installed) inherit FullConstructor and so its table. Paths end at the module item yaml.constructor. Checked against the record's tree fe15062 (5.3.1-15-gfe15062, first parent of the fix a001f27, which is in 5.4b1 and 5.4) on 2026-11-04, lib3/ copy (lib/ is the Python 2 copy).
